angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 935,717 km at 185.68 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.3855 +/- 0.0249 mas (same row, RUWE 0.91): 185.68 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.345 +/- 0.046 solar radii from Rodriguez et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-628 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..194R/abstract): 935,717 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.311 +/- 0.066 solar masses from Rodriguez et al. 2021, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-628 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..194R/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6250 +/- 220 K from Rodriguez et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-628 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..194R/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Rodriguez et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-628 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..194R/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-628.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.298, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 288842: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-628 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.258 dex, from Rodriguez et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..194R/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-628 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.39445, from Rodriguez et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..194R/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-628 (pscomppars): age 1.28 Gyr, from Rodriguez et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..194R/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-628 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 6.9 km/s, from Rodriguez et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..194R/abstract)
